name: citation_format
description: Format references in APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago author-date, IEEE or Vancouver (NLM) from CSL-JSON items or a BibTeX string: journal articles, books, chapters, conference papers, reports, theses and web pages, with author lists, et al. rules, page ranges and DOIs. Plain text and Markdown with italics.

items.description: CSL-JSON: type, title, author [{family, given}], issued {date-parts}, container-title, volume, issue, page, DOI, URL, publisher, publisher-place, edition, editor

bibtex.description: One or more BibTeX entries instead of items

references.text: 1. Halpern SD, Ubel PA, Caplan AL. Solid-organ transplantation in HIV-infected patients. N Engl J Med. 2002 Jul 25;347(4):284-7.

catalog.source: original; rules from the APA Publication Manual (7th ed.), MLA Handbook (9th ed.), Chicago Manual of Style (17th ed.), IEEE Reference Guide and NLM Citing Medicine; CSL-JSON input as in citation-style-language/styles
